Alex Mercer
Senior Full-Stack & AI Engineer
Email: alex.mercer@example.dev | Location: Remote / San Francisco, CA

SUMMARY:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience specializing in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Python, and cloud architectures. B.S. in Computer Science — University of California, Berkeley
